scores.notes: Moses in both is an old man with long white hair and a full white beard, weathered face, dark brown cloak over a pale tunic (left with staff at shore, right seated on the stone).
David in both is a slim clean-shaven teenage youth with short dark curly hair and tanned skin in a short brown tunic (left dodging the spear, right smaller with the sling); no conflicting cue.

Moses in both is an elderly man with white swept-back hair and a full white beard, lean tanned face, dark brown cloak over a pale robe with a wooden staff (left foreground, right seated on the stone).

Daniel in both has short cropped grey hair and a short grey beard, lean tanned face, a dark blue fringed mantle over a pale tunic and a scroll case at the hip (small in the den on the left, large on the right).

Both show a night-time parted sea under heavy dark cloud with a wet sandy-rocky seabed path between teal-green water and distant rocky headlands; left views it from the shore, right from inside the path where the walls tower higher.

Moses in both is an old man with white swept-back hair and a full white beard, weathered tanned face, brown cloak over a pale robe and a staff (left standing by the camp, right seated with arms raised).

Peter (left foreground by the brazier, right standing on the boat's bow) has short curly dark hair going grey, a short grey-flecked beard, tanned skin and a rough brown cloak over a pale tunic in both.
David in both is a slim clean-shaven youth with dark curly hair and tanned skin in a short brown tunic (left kneeling under the oil, right dodging the spear at far right).

Both show an open circular pit lined with pale grey stone blocks sunk into sandy ground, with stone steps and a wall beside it and a pale early sky; the right is brighter and adds palms and a barred gate but nothing conflicts.

Moses in both is an old man with white wavy hair and a full white beard, tanned lined face, a brown cloak over a pale belted robe and a crooked staff (left raising the rod at the rock, right at the shore).

On the left Jesus is only a tiny distant figure on the cross on the hilltop with no readable face, hair or beard; the right shows him clearly (long brown hair, beard, blue mantle), so identity cannot be compared.
David in both is a slim clean-shaven teenage youth with short dark curly hair and tanned skin in a ragged brown tunic with a shoulder pouch (left kneeling under the oil, right crouched at the brook).

Both show the same kind of open wooden fishing boat with a single mast and furled sail on a wide lake ringed by low hills with a small hillside village on shore; the storm-night versus calm-dawn change is the one the passages ask for.

Left Peter (raising the lame man) has thick dark-grey curly hair, a grizzled dark beard and a heavy build; the man diving from the boat on the right has thin silver-white hair, a white-grey beard and an older, leaner face.

Both show a sandy seabed path between blue-green water under a dark cloudy moonlit sky, with tan rocky cliffs and a walled town on the far shore; left is seen from inside the path with towering walls, right from the beach as the waters open.

Both show a broad path running straight between towering dark-green walls of water under a dark night sky toward rocky hills with a crag at the far end; the ground is darker and muddier on the left and sandier on the right, and the left wall is paler, but the layout agrees.

Peter (left foreground by the brazier, right clasping the lame man's hand with a net over his shoulder) has short dark curly hair with grey, a short greying beard, tanned skin and a rough brown cloak in both; he is smaller and slightly darker-haired on the right.

Daniel in both has short cropped grey hair, a short grey beard and a lean lined face, wearing a dark blue fringed mantle over a pale tunic with a scroll case at the hip; skin reads darker on the right under night lighting only.
Peter (left standing on the bow, right centre front with staff and net) has short curly dark-grey hair, a short greying beard, tanned skin and a rough brown cloak over a pale tunic in both.

Jesus pointing at the tomb (left) and on the cross at the top edge (right, small) both show shoulder-length dark brown hair, a dark beard, the same skin tone and lean build, even the same cream robe with blue mantle; the right face is small but nothing conflicts.

Moses is the seated elder with raised arms (left) and the elder leading the crowd with a staff (right); both have white hair, a long white beard, an aged face and a cream robe under a dark mantle. A second white-bearded elder stands beside him on the right but looks alike, so the match holds either way.

Moses with arm outstretched over the sea (left, in profile from behind) and the elder with the staff in the foreground (right) both have white hair, a full white beard, an aged tanned face and a dark mantle over a cream robe; hair is a little longer on the left but nothing clearly conflicts.
Moses seated with raised arms (left) and the elder with a crook at the right of the crowd (right, small) both have white hair and a long white beard, aged face, and a dark mantle over a pale robe.

Daniel on the left has close-cropped grey hair and dark brown skin; on the right he has full wavy grey hair swept back over the ears and a clearly lighter complexion with a different face, though robe, beard and age are alike.

Both show a pale-dawn pebble beach on a calm lake ringed by terraced tan-green hills with cypress, palms and a flat-roofed village, with a wooden boat and nets at the water's edge; the village sits on opposite sides, consistent with a turned viewpoint.
Daniel pointing before the king (left) and standing among the lions (right, small) both have short grey hair, a short grey beard, tan skin, a lean older face and the same blue robe over cream.

Jesus standing on the water (left, small and distant) and gesturing before the tomb (right) both have shoulder-length dark brown hair, a dark beard, the same slim build and a grey-blue mantle over a cream robe; the left face is tiny but no cue conflicts.

Peter stepping from the boat (left) and diving toward shore (right) is the same sturdy middle-aged man with short curly dark-greying hair, a short grey beard, tan skin and a brown cloak over a pale tunic.

Jesus on the left is a tiny distant figure on the water at the far edge, only a few pixels of head; long dark hair and a blue mantle over a pale robe agree with the right, but the face, beard and age cannot be made out well enough to judge identity.

On the left the likely Peter (front man draped in a net; every man in the group is similar) has thick dark curly hair and a dark beard with only a little grey; the diving Peter on the right has white-grey thinning hair and a white-grey beard and looks clearly older.

Jesus on the right is a tiny distant haloed figure on the water with only a few pixels of head; dark long hair and a blue mantle over a pale robe agree with the crucified figure on the left, but face, beard and age cannot be judged at that size.

Jesus on the left is large and clear (long dark hair, dark beard, blue-grey mantle), but on the right the haloed figure on the water is tiny with only a few pixels of head, and a second similar blue-mantled man stands in the boat's stern; identity cannot be judged.
David crouching at the brook (left) and dodging by the wall (right) is the same clean-shaven teenage boy with short dark curly hair, tan skin and slim build.

Both show a sandy seabed corridor between walls of dark teal sea under a dark cloudy night sky, with rocky headlands at the shore; left looks back at the crowd with the hills behind and far taller water walls, right looks out from the shore toward a fire glow, a compatible opposite viewpoint.
David with the sling (left, small) and crouching with the staff (right) is the same clean-shaven teenage boy with short dark curly hair, tan skin, slim build and a brown tunic with a shoulder bag.

David dodging the spear (left) and crouching at the brook (right) both have short dark curly hair, tan skin and no beard; he looks a few years younger and rounder-faced on the left, but still a youth in both, not a clear age conflict.

Moses with arm stretched over the sea (left) and the elder with a crook at the right of the crowd (right, small) both have white hair, a long white beard, an aged face and a dark mantle over a pale robe.
Daniel in both is an older man with short grey hair, short grey beard, tan skin and slim build in a blue robe over a white tunic (left standing before the king, right small but clear in the pit).

Peter in both has dark curly hair greying at the temples, a short greying beard, tanned skin and sturdy build in a rough brown cloak with a net slung on him (standing with staff left, leaping from the boat right).
David in both is a slim clean-shaven teenage boy with short dark curly hair and tan skin in a short brown tunic (slinging at left, dodging the spear at right).

Both show a wet sandy corridor running to a vanishing point between two towering curling walls of blue-green water under a dark stormy sky; the right shows more rocky cliffs at the far end but nothing conflicts.

Peter (the man raising the beggar at left; foreground man with net and staff at right) has short dark curly hair greying at the sides, a short grizzled beard, deep tan skin and a sturdy build in a rough brown cloak in both.

Left Daniel (being hauled out of the pit) has close-cropped grey hair and darker tan skin; right Daniel has thick wavy collar-length hair streaked dark and grey, a longer face and lighter skin, despite the same blue robe and scroll.

Left Daniel has thick wavy collar-length grey-and-dark hair and lighter skin; right Daniel in the pit has close-cropped receding grey hair and darker skin and looks older, with only the blue robe in common.
David in both is a slim clean-shaven boy with short dark curly hair in a rough brown tunic; his head is bowed on the right so the face is partly hidden, but hair, age and build agree.

Both show the same kind of wooden boat with a lit lantern hung at the mast and a ragged pale sail on a lake backed by dark hills under heavy cloud; the right shore is nearer with villages, but that fits a different viewpoint and the storm-to-calm change.

Both show a calm, misty Sea of Galilee at low sun with hazy steep hills around the water and a scrubby shoreline; the left sees the shore from the boat and the right from the beach, with no conflicting feature.

Both show a small wooden fishing boat swamped by steep dark waves at night with the moon breaking through storm cloud; the left adds a hillside shore and a furled sail while the right has open water and a set sail, but the stormy night lake matches.
Moses in both is an old man with white hair and a full white beard in a cream tunic with dark sash and brown mantle, holding a staff; he is small on the right but hair, beard and build clearly match.

Daniel in both is an older lean man with close-cropped grey hair, a short grey beard and tan skin wearing a dark blue fringed mantle over a pale tunic; he is smaller on the left but hair and beard match.

Moses (foreground with staff at left; the staff-bearer leading the crowd at right) is an old man with white hair, a full white beard and tan skin in a cream tunic and brown mantle in both; small on the right, and a near-twin elder walks beside him, but nothing conflicts.

Both show a wooden fishing boat with a lit lantern on a black, heaving lake at night with the moon breaking through storm cloud and a faint dark shoreline; the right adds distant boats but nothing conflicts.
Peter stepping from the boat (left) and in the courtyard foreground (right) both have dark curly hair greying at the temples, a short grey-flecked beard, tanned middle-aged face and stocky build.
Daniel being hauled from the den (left) and pointing before the king (right) is the same lean older man with short cropped grey hair, short grey beard and tan skin, in the same blue fringed robe.
Peter diving from the boat (left, face small and tilted down) and in the courtyard (right) both show dark curly hair, a short dark beard, tanned skin and a stocky build; no cue conflicts.
Moses striking the rock (left) and seated with arms held up (right) is the same old man with swept-back white hair, full white beard and tanned lined face.

Peter at the bow with net and staff (left) and at the front of the group by the fire (right) both have dark curly hair touched with grey, a short greying dark beard and tan skin, with the same net over the shoulder.
Peter raising the lame man (left) and stepping from the boat (right) both have dark curly hair greying at the sides, a short grey-flecked beard, tan skin and sturdy build.

Both show a dry hillside with olive trees, low stone walls and flat-roofed stone houses above a lake with moored boats on the right and a white building on the slope; the white building is colonnaded on the left and domed on the right, but the layout is compatible.
David kneeling at the brook (left) and kneeling to be anointed (right) is the same slim clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair and fair skin; the right face is bowed but nothing conflicts.

Both show a single-masted open wooden fishing boat with a lantern on a dark storm-tossed sea under a moon breaking through clouds, with a dark headland on the horizon; extra boats and lightning on the left are compatible.
Daniel pointing before the king (left) and standing in the pit (right, small) both have cropped grey hair, a short grey beard, tan skin and lean build in a dark blue fringed robe.

Peter clasping the lame man's hand (left) and standing centre on the shore (right) both have dark curly hair, a short dark beard greying at the chin, tan skin and sturdy build, with net and staff in both.

Moses seated with arms held up (left) and raising the rod at the rock (right) is the same aged man with white hair, full white beard and tanned face; hair is a little longer on the right but nothing conflicts.
Moses seated with arms supported (left) and holding the staff toward the sea (right, in profile from behind) both show long white hair, a full white beard and an aged tanned face.

David dodging the spear (left) and kneeling at the brook (right) is a slim clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair and fair ruddy skin in both; he looks slightly younger on the left but no cue conflicts.
Daniel watching the vision (left) and standing in the pit (right, small) both have cropped grey hair, a short grey beard, tan skin and lean build in the same dark blue fringed robe.
Moses with staff before the parted sea (left, in profile from behind) and seated with arms held up (right) both have white hair, a full white beard and aged tanned face.

David slinging (left, small) and kneeling to be anointed (right, head bowed) both show a slim clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair and light tan skin in a brown tunic; faces are small but no cue conflicts.

Peter gripping the lame man's hand (left) and front of the group at the fire (right) both have short curly hair, a short greying beard, tan weathered face and stocky build with a net on the shoulder; hair is greyer on the left but both are dark going grey.

Moses raising the rod at the rock (left) and facing the parted sea (right, in profile from behind) both have long white hair, a full white beard and aged tanned face with the same dark cloak over a pale tunic.

Peter standing at the front left of the courtyard (left) and at the bow of the boat (right) both have short dark hair going grey, a short grey-flecked dark beard, tan skin and sturdy build with a net on the shoulder.

Peter standing in the courtyard (left) and gripping the lame man's hand (right) both have a short greying beard, tan weathered face, strong brow and stocky build with a net on the shoulder; hair is curlier and greyer on the right but both read as dark going grey.

On the right Peter is the grey-curly-haired, grey-bearded man lifting the beggar, but the left shows about eleven near-identical dark-haired bearded disciples around the fire and nothing singles out which one is Peter.

Both show the same kind of open wooden fishing boat with a lit lantern hanging from the mast on open grey-blue water under heavy cloud; the left is mid-storm in moonlight and the right calm with a paler twilight sky and a distant shore, which fits the storm-then-calm change asked for.

Moses is the white-haired, long-white-bearded elder with a staff walking ahead of the crowd on the left and the seated white-haired, white-bearded elder with arms held up on the right; hair, beard, age and dark cloak over pale robe agree.

Jesus is a slim man with shoulder-length dark brown hair and a short dark beard, wearing a blue mantle over a pale tunic, standing in the boat on the left and before the tomb on the right; face, hair, beard and build agree.

Both are night scenes under heavy dark cloud with teal-green walls of water flanking a wet, rocky seabed corridor and a hill town on the far shore; the left looks down the corridor from inside and the right from the near shore, which is compatible.

Peter is the stocky man with short curly dark hair and a full beard diving from the boat on the left and stepping on the water on the right; the right shows some grey in hair and beard under moonlight but hair style, beard, build and skin tone agree.

Jesus on the central cross at left is small but shows shoulder-length dark hair, a dark beard and a blue mantle over a pale robe, matching the long-dark-haired, bearded man in the same blue mantle before the tomb at right; no cue conflicts.

Moses is the old man with white hair and a full white beard, brown cloak over a pale robe and a crook staff, walking at the front on the left and raising the staff at the rock on the right; hair, beard and age agree.

Peter is the sturdy tan-skinned man with short curly grey hair and a grey beard, a net over his shoulder, stepping from the bow on the left and lifting the beggar on the right; hair, beard, age and build match.

Jesus is the man with shoulder-length dark hair and a dark beard in a blue mantle over a pale robe before the tomb on the left and, smaller, standing on the water on the right; hair, beard and build agree with no conflicting cue.

Moses is the white-haired, white-bearded old man with a crook staff and dark cloak standing beside the priest on the left and, in profile from behind, stretching the staff over the sea on the right; hair, beard, age and build agree.

Jesus is the slim man with shoulder-length dark brown hair and a short dark beard in a blue-grey mantle over a pale robe, standing in the boat on the left and, smaller, on the water at far right; hair, beard and build agree.
David is the slim clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair and tan skin kneeling to be anointed on the left and slinging the stone on the right; hair, age, build and beardless face match.

On the right Peter is the large foreground man with curly dark hair and a greying beard, but the left shows about eleven small, near-identical dark-haired bearded disciples round the fire and nothing reliably singles out which is Peter.

Moses is the old man with white hair and a full white beard, dark-brown cloak over a pale robe and a crook staff, walking ahead of the crowd on the left and standing beside the priest on the right; hair, beard, age and build agree.
Daniel is the lean older man with short grey hair and a grey beard in a dark-blue mantle over a pale robe with a waist pouch, standing in the pit in both images; hair, beard, age and build match.

David is the slim, clean-shaven, fair-tan youth with short dark curly hair in a rough brown tunic, slinging on the left and kneeling at the brook on the right; the left is smaller but hair, age and build agree.

Jesus is the slim man with shoulder-length dark brown hair and a short dark beard in a dark-blue mantle over a pale robe, pointing at the tomb on the left and standing in the boat on the right; face, hair, beard and build match.

Jesus is small in both but shows shoulder-length dark hair, a dark beard and a blue mantle over a pale robe, standing on the water on the left and on the central cross on the right; the visible hair, beard and build agree with no conflict.

Peter in the courtyard on the left is a middle-aged man with short dark hair and a dark beard; the man diving from the boat on the right has grey-white hair and a grey beard and looks clearly older, so hair colour and age conflict.

Peter is the sturdy man with short curly dark-grey hair and a greying beard with a net over his shoulder, large in the left foreground of the courtyard and standing forward with a staff by the fire on the right; hair, beard, age and build agree.

Jesus on the cross (left, small and cropped at the forehead by the top edge) and standing in the boat (right): both have dark shoulder-length hair, short dark beard, similar skin tone and slim build; face detail on left is limited but no cue conflicts.

Both show a brown seabed path cut through dark teal sea under a dark stormy night sky with rocky headlands behind; left is the opening seen from shore with low wave walls, right is inside the path with much taller walls - walls differ in height but the place and time of day are compatible.

Jesus standing on the water (left, distant) and standing in the stern (right): both have long dark hair past the shoulders, dark beard, slim build (and the same blue mantle over pale tunic); left figure is small and dim but cues agree.

Moses with staff leading the crowd (left) and raising the staff on the rock (right): both an old man with white hair, long white beard, tan skin, same staff and dark cloak over pale robe; right is seen partly from behind but hair and beard agree.

David kneeling to be anointed (left, head bowed in profile) and after slinging (right, mid-distance): both a beardless slim youth with short dark curly hair and tanned skin, same age, same rough brown tunic; right hair looks slightly shorter but no conflict.

Both are a small wooden single-masted fishing boat with a hanging lantern on a dark night sea with a moon behind clouds and a dark hilly shoreline; left shows the storm, right the calming as the texts ask - boat, lake and hills are compatible.

Peter standing in the courtyard (left) and the front figure with the net on the beach (right): both have short curly dark hair with grey, short grizzled beard, tanned skin, broad sturdy build, brown cloak with a net over the shoulder.

Left Jesus is clear: long dark hair, dark beard, blue-grey mantle over pale tunic. Right Jesus is a tiny distant figure on the cross at the top-right hilltop - only dark hair and a blue-and-pale garment can be made out, no face, so identity cannot be judged.

Peter standing on the bow (left) has thick dark curly hair with some grey and a dark grizzled beard, about fifty; the Peter diving from the boat (right) has short light-grey/white thinning hair and a white-grey beard and looks clearly older. Hair colour and apparent age conflict (right figure is fairly small, but the pale hair is plain).

Both show a hillside olive grove with low dry-stone walls, a lake in the distance and the same golden late-day sky; left is the dirt road with a tan flat-roofed house behind, right is beside the house on stone paving. The house reads tan-plastered with an arch on the left and grey cut stone on the right, and the right adds a white columned building, but land, water, walls, trees and light are compatible for road vs doorstep viewpoints.

Daniel standing among the lions (left, small) and being hauled up on the rope (right): both have short cropped grey hair, short grey beard, tanned lean face, slim older build and the same blue fringed robe over a pale tunic.

Both show the same rocky muddy seabed path between towering dark teal wave walls under a moonlit stormy night sky with rocky hills at the far end; right adds a walled town on the far ridge but the corridor, water and night lighting match.

Daniel on the rope at the den mouth (left) and pointing before the king (right): both have short cropped grey hair, short grey beard, tanned lean face, slim older build and the same blue fringed robe with scroll case.

Moses with arms raised seen in back-three-quarter profile (left) and the staff-bearing old man at the front of the crowd (right): both have white hair, full white beard, aged tanned face, dark brown cloak over pale robe and the same crook; left face is partly turned away but hair, beard and age agree.

Peter in the left foreground by the brazier (left) and leaping from the boat with a net on his back (right): both have short curly dark hair going grey, short grizzled beard, weathered tan face, stocky middle-aged build and brown cloak.

Moses raising the staff with water arcing (left) and standing with the crook beside the priest (right): both an old man with white-grey hair, full white beard, deep tan lined face, dark brown cloak over pale robe and similar build.

Moses with the crook looking up (left) and raising the crook at the rock (right): both an old man with swept-back white hair, full white beard, tanned lined face, brown cloak over pale robe and lean build.

Daniel standing among the lions (left, small) and being drawn up on ropes (right): both have short cropped grey hair, short grey beard, tanned lean face, slim older build and the same blue fringed robe with satchel over a pale tunic.

Jesus standing in the boat (left) and on the centre cross in the background (right, small): both have long dark hair to the shoulders, dark beard, slim build and the same blue mantle over a pale tunic; the right face is too small for fine detail but hair, beard and build agree and nothing conflicts.

Right Peter is clear (stepping onto the water, curly dark hair going grey, grizzled beard). On the left about ten near-identical dark-haired bearded disciples stand round the fire and none is singled out as Peter; the likeliest candidate (net over shoulder, holding a staff) is small and looks darker-haired, so identity cannot be judged.

Both show a sunlit hillside above a lake with a white flat-roofed village, the same white columned building, cypresses, olive trees and low cut-stone walls on sandy ground; left is the road outside, right the stone house terrace, compatible viewpoints of one place.

Both show a calm dawn lakeshore with a flat-roofed stone village at the water's edge, cypresses and a coal fire on the bank; right adds palms and is seen from the water, which is a compatible viewpoint change.

Both show the same open wooden boat with a mast lantern on a dark night lake, a hilly shore with a small village on the left and the moon low over the far shore; rougher water on the right is the asked-for storm.
Peter (diving from the boat left, lifting the lame man right) has short dark curly hair, a short dark beard, tanned skin and a sturdy build in both; the left face is angled down but the cues agree.
Moses is an old tanned man with white hair, white beard, cream robe, brown mantle and staff in both; hair and beard are somewhat longer on the right but colour, age and build match.

Left is a narrow lake in pale twilight with terraced hillside villages close on both shores; right is open water at full night under a moon with lightning and only faint distant shore, and no description asks for a night/day change.

David is a slim clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair, fair-tan skin and a rough brown tunic in both (crouched at the brook left, kneeling under the oil right); his head is bowed on the right but hair, age and build match.

Peter is clear on the left (the dark-curly-haired bearded man diving), but on the right eleven near-identical dark-bearded men in brown cloaks stand round the fire and nothing singles out which is Peter.
Moses is the old man with swept-back white hair, full white beard, cream robe, brown mantle and crook-topped staff in both (arm out at the sea left, looking up in the camp right).
Moses is the old man with white hair, full white beard, cream robe, brown mantle and crook-topped staff in both; he is small at the right edge of the sea crossing but the cues are visible and match.

Both are a night scene under heavy dark storm cloud with the same green foaming sea drawn back from a wet sandy bed; the left sees the opening from the beach, the right looks along the corridor between the water walls, a compatible viewpoint.
David is a slim clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair, fair-tan skin and a plain brown tunic in both (kneeling with head bowed left, dodging the spear right).
David is a slim beardless youth with short dark hair and a brown belted tunic in both; he is small in the left battlefield but hair, age, build and skin tone match the right.

Peter (stepping out of the boat left, the man with net and staff clasping the beggar's hand right) has short dark curly hair touched with grey, a short greying dark beard, tanned skin and a sturdy build in both.
Both show the same round open-topped pit lined with grey stone blocks on sandy ground, with a barred grate under a wooden hatch at the rim and palms behind, in pale early daylight.
Jesus has shoulder-length dark brown hair, a short dark beard, the same lean face and build and a cream robe with grey-blue mantle in both (at the tomb left, standing in the stern right).
David is a slim beardless youth with short black curly hair, tanned skin and a rough brown tunic with shoulder bag in both; he is smaller on the right battlefield but hair, age and build match.
Jesus is a tiny distant figure on the cross on the left with no legible face; on the right he is also small (long dark hair, beard, pale robe), so identity cannot be compared.

Daniel is the lean older man with close-cropped grey hair, short grey beard and olive-brown skin in a dark blue mantle over cream with a satchel, in the left foreground and standing among the lions on the right.

Peter raising the lame man on the left and leaping from the boat on the right both have short dark curly hair going grey, a short dark beard, tanned skin and a sturdy build, with a net over the shoulder.
Daniel among the lions on the left and in the right foreground both have close-cropped grey hair, a short grey beard, a lean older olive-skinned face and the same dark blue mantle over a pale robe.

Moses seated with raised arms on the left and striking the rock on the right is the same old man with white hair, a full white beard, weathered tanned skin and a brown mantle over a pale robe; hair and beard are a little longer on the left.

Moses seated between the two men on the left and standing with the staff on the right is an old man with white hair, a full white beard, weathered tanned skin and a brown mantle over a pale robe; hair is fuller and longer on the left but nothing clearly conflicts.
Daniel pointing on the left and looking up on the right has the same close-cropped grey hair, short grey beard, lean older olive-brown face and dark blue mantle over a pale robe with a satchel.
Moses stretching his staff over the sea on the left (side-on) and striking with the rod on the right is an old man with flowing white hair, a full white beard and a brown mantle over a pale robe.

Both show the same kind of round open pit lined with large grey stone blocks, with a broad flat rim, sandy floor and dry scrubby ground around, seen from above; the left view takes in a gate, steps and a wall with palms while the right looks out to an empty plain, compatible with opposite viewpoints.
Moses holding the staff at the front of the crowd on the left and raising the rod on the right is an old man with white hair, a full white beard, tanned skin and a brown mantle over a pale robe.
